extension.description: Generate reviewable pull request titles and descriptions from committed Git changes using the local Codex CLI, with read-only safety boundaries.
capability.untrusted: Codex PR Safe reads Git history and diffs and runs the local Codex CLI. Trust the workspace before using it.
capability.virtual: Codex PR Safe requires a local filesystem-backed Git repository.

command.openPullRequest.title: Open GitHub PR

config.codexPath: Path or command name of the local Codex CLI. This setting is user-only and cannot be overridden by repository config.
config.model: Optional Codex model override. Leave empty to use the Codex CLI default. User-only.
config.language: Language used for generated PR prose.
config.baseBranch: Optional default base ref, for example origin/main. Leave empty for local auto-detection.
config.maxDiffBytes: Maximum textual PR diff bytes sent to Codex. Oversized PRs fail closed instead of being silently truncated.
config.maxCommitBytes: Maximum bytes of commit-list context sent to Codex.
config.titleMaxLength: Preferred maximum PR title length. Longer generated titles are locally shortened with an ellipsis.
config.includePullRequestTemplate: Include a small repository PR template as untrusted reference context when present.
config.extraInstructions: Optional team style guidance. It cannot override safety or evidence rules.
